title: Anacephalaeosis: Epiphanius' Recapitulation of the Faith
pass_a_gloss: Anacephalaeosis (Recapitulation/Summary). Epiphanius of Salamis provides a concise recapitulation of the orthodox faith and a summary refutation of heresies. It serves as a concise handbook of orthodox doctrine. Covers: the Trinity, the Incarnation, the Holy Spirit, the Church, the Sacraments, the Resurrection, and the Last Judgment. It follows the structure of the Ancoratus but is more concise. It includes the Nicene Creed and the Constantinopolitan Creed. Epiphanius wrote this as a handbook for bishops and clergy.
notes_covered: ANF 4 (Crombie) has English translation; new English from Greek required
